name: crm-command-menu
title: Company command menu
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Command palette that searches companies and lists matches as a compact result table. Optional actions sit above the results.

meta.descriptionEs: Paleta que busca empresas y muestra las coincidencias en una tabla compacta.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, treinta filas y un nombre sin espacios.

meta.usage:
<CrmCommandMenu
  companies={companies}
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  onSelectCompany={openCompany}
  actions={[{ id: "create", label: "New company" }]}
  onSelectAction={runAction}
/>

api.name: companies
api.description: Searched by name, owner, status, industry, region, and email.

api.name: open / onOpenChange
api.description: Controlled dialog. hotkey listens for Cmd-K or Ctrl-K unless you pass false.

api.name: actions / onSelectAction
api.description: Commands shown above the company table.

api.name: formatValue / labels
api.description: Pipeline text and the palette copy. Defaults are English.

docs: Clean-room behavior inspired by github.com/kargulstudio/sales-crm, which publishes no license. No source, class names, colors, copy, or assets were copied. It uses the host command dialog. command-palette remains the grouped command list and does not search records. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite avatar, badge, command, or dialog. The item ships no theme. Each result is an option whose name includes the status, owner, and value. The list stops at 20 matches.
